items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I went to see Jay McShane.

ctx.x: A couple of questions about some clubs. Did you ever go to the Rhythm Club? Did you know the Rhythm Club?

I went to the Rhythm Club one time. I went to see Jay McShane. And I brought my cousin. My cousin, he and his wife, they had a little spat. I said, come on man, you need to get away from this kind of stuff. So he and I, we went back to the Rhythm Club back on Jackson Avenue. Right. There was another club back on the Coliseum.
